changelog:
Initial release of Juncheng Industrial AI skill:

- Analyzes PLC programs, including ladder diagram, SCL, and STL code for logic errors.
- Designs industrial automation solutions by generating PLC program frameworks from process flowcharts.
- Diagnoses equipment faults by analyzing alarm codes and historical data.
- Generates SCADA reports (daily, weekly, monthly) from raw sensor data.
